findings.title: Criterion 2 durable issuance rows has no direct assertion in the retained RED
findings.evidence: tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b0u-successor-replay-red.test.ts:397-400 asserts projection-derived operation identities, not a direct issuance-store read.

findings.title: Second-callback test does not pin authentication-before-callback ordering on the recovered attempt
findings.evidence: The second test does not assert authenticated-projection-base and validated-application-state precede the successful recovered attempt's commit events.
findings.impact: The replayable d1,d1,d2 count alone would not detect callbacks occurring before successor base validation on retry.
findings.required_action: f5b0v GREEN author: assert the second authentication/validation events precede the recovered attempt's first commit event.

contract_assessment: Correct and honest. Canonical state is exact-once by digest; neither DurableLiveJournalStore nor DurableIssuanceStore exposes a per-consumer delivery cursor or receipt; fail-closed cleanup is preserved; digest is a valid idempotency key. Exactly-once external effects require an application-owned atomic effect/idempotency port.
consumer_assessment: No production consumer requires durable exactly-once callback effects. v3-chat and grid use no-op callbacks and derive state from onProjection. Room-internal consumers are bounded in-memory reconstruction observers checked against canonical evidence.
red_green_assessment: RED 488a22a6/692b4add is causal and validated. The explicit replayable d1,d1,d2 expectation is discriminating if canonical exact-once checks remain; the three P2 gaps are concrete but nonblocking.
